en: Hiiiii, you guys!

Hey, hey! Have you decided how you wanna
spend your final moments?
Maybe...you wanna pray to Atua with me?

Wh-What!? You shouldn't be giving up
so easily!
Nyahahaha! True, true.

You two get along so well. I was hopin' it'd
rub off on the others in the dining hall.
Huh? What are you talking about?

Atua has spoken... In such dire times, why
won't they stop fighting?
F-Fighting!?

Ummmm, they're fighting in the dining hall.
Atua is really bummed out about it.
<CLT=cltMIND>Fighting...in the dining hall?

Shuichi, can you go get the stuff from Miu?
I have to see what's happening.

...Okay.
I'll go get the cameras.

Let's meet up later at the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>classroom by the stairs to the basement<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>classroom by the stairs to the basement<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
Okay, got it.

Angie, you said the dining hall, right?
Do you mind coming with me?
Okie-dokie, we'll stop it together.
<CLT=cltMIND>Who's fighting who though? And why?

Hm, what's up? You look super panicked.
Are you here to stop the fighting?

Y-Yeah, I am! If you know about the fight,
why aren't you stopping—

Why should I? Something's finally happened
to break up all the boring tedium.
Boring!?
Besides, you know, don't you Kaede?

The time limit ends at 10 p.m. tonight!
It's just around the corner!

If people feel like they need to take action to
survive...who are you to stop them, Kaede?

<CLT=cltMIND>Geez! This would be way simpler if I
could just share Shuichi's plan with everyone!

But, by the same token, who am I to stop
you from stopping them?
So...go stop them! I believe in you!
<CLT=cltMIND>That's...definitely a lie!

So...put an end to their fighting!
I believe in you!
<CLT=cltMIND>That's...definitely a lie!

Oh, Maki! Did you hear about the fight
in the dining hall!?
...Yeah, Angie told me. Stay out of it.
I can't just stay out of it!
...Why not?
Huh...?
Because it could start the killing game?
Th-That's right! I won't let that happen!
...Right.

Then what are you wasting time with me for?
Get out of here.
<CLT=cltMIND>She's right... I need to hurry!
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>This door was blocked before...
When did it become accessible?

<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Area Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick
(Closed)

<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Area Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick
(Open)
